title: Counting $t$-wise $L$-intersecting cliques with prescribed intersection sizes
summary: Let $r,t\ge 3$ be integers and $L=\{\ell_1,\ell_2,\ldots,\ell_s\}\subseteq [0,r-1]$ a fixed set of integers with $|L|\neq r$ and $\ell_1<\ell_2<\cdots<\ell_s$. For each integer $n$, let $Ψ_{r}(n,L,t)$ be the maximum number of $r$-cliques in an $n$-vertex graph whose $r$-cliques, viewed as a family of $r$-subsets of the vertex set, form a $t$-wise $L$-intersecting family. In this paper, we prove that $Ψ_{r}(n,L,t)=o(n^{|L|})$ when the sequence $\ell_1,\ell_2,\ldots,\ell_s,r$ does not form an arithmetic progression, and we give an asymptotic formula for $Ψ_{r}(n,L,t)$ when this sequence does…
